feedback: This candidate adopts the Evaluator's previous suggestions: increasing kd to 1.2 to improve damping and reduce oscillations, reducing sensor_weights magnitude to [-1.2, -0.6, 0, 0.6, 1.2] to soften steering sensitivity, and slightly increasing base_speed to 1.35 to regain pace. Geometry remains unchanged, which is reasonable given its prior effectiveness. Earlier races showed that too high kd (3) caused oscillations and line loss on the s-bend, while too low kd (0.8) led to off-track termination. The reduced sensor weights and increased kd should balance stability and responsiveness. The next race will confirm if these changes reduce line loss and oscillations on sharp bends without sacrificing speed. Depending on the next race results, consider tuning ki to improve steady-state error correction if oscillations persist or adjusting sensor positions slightly to improve line detection on bends.
